works.idea_en: Sampling cases from a structured database gives LLM patients variety with a handle on what varies, a practical answer to the control problem.
works.idea_zh: 从结构化数据库中抽样病例，让大语言模型病人既有多样性，又能把握“变的是什么”——这是对可控性问题的一个务实回答。
works.method: Unity application combining speech processing, an LLM conditioned on a generated case and 3D avatars; expert user study (n=13) on usability, realism and educational value.
works.method_zh: Unity 应用，结合语音处理、以生成病例为条件的大语言模型与三维化身；以专家用户研究（n=13）评估易用性、真实感与教学价值。

paper.title: CLiVR: Conversational Learning System in Virtual Reality with AI-Powered Patients

works.title: Integrating Virtual Reality and Large Language Models for Team-Based Non-Technical Skills Training and Evaluation in the Operating Room
works.description: VORTeX is a multi-user VR operating room in which surgical teams handle laparoscopic emergencies (pneumothorax, intra-abdominal bleeding); an LLM then classifies the team's dialogue against the NOTSS framework and draws networks of who leads and who integrates.
works.description_zh: VORTeX 是一个多人 VR 手术室，外科团队在其中处理腹腔镜手术中的紧急情况（气胸、腹腔内出血）；随后由大语言模型依据 NOTSS 框架对团队对话进行分类，并绘制谁在主导、谁在整合信息的互动网络。
works.idea_en: Here the LLM is the measurement instrument, not the scenario: automated, structured coding of team behavior adds experimental control instead of removing it.
works.idea_zh: 这里的大语言模型是测量工具而非情境本身：对团队行为进行自动化、结构化的编码，是在增强而非削弱实验控制。
works.method: Multi-user VR simulation with recorded team speech; structured prompts derived from NOTSS classify behaviors and build directed communication graphs; pilot with 12 surgical professionals at SAGES 2024.
works.method_zh: 多人 VR 模拟并录制团队语音；依据 NOTSS 设计的结构化提示词对行为分类并构建有向沟通图；在 SAGES 2024 上由 12 名外科专业人员试用。

paper.title: Integrating Virtual Reality and Large Language Models for Team-Based Non-Technical Skills Training and Evaluation in the Operating Room

works.title: Inceptor: Automated Generation of Social Scenarios in Virtual Reality
works.description: Pipeline that turns written scenario descriptions into social VR episodes with animated virtual characters; for a mental-health resilience training project it produced 32 episodes, more than two hours of content, in a short time, and the authors tested an LLM for choosing character animations.
works.description_zh: 一条把文字情境描述转化为带动画虚拟角色的社会 VR 片段的流水线；在一个心理健康韧性训练项目中，它在短时间内生成了 32 个片段、总时长超过两小时，作者还测试了用大语言模型为角色挑选动画。
works.idea_en: Generating many short social scenes of authored quality is where generation already pays off for training, before any live LLM conversation.
works.idea_zh: 在实时大语言模型对话之前，批量生成接近人工制作水准的简短社会场景，已经让训练受益。
works.method: Automated authoring pipeline from scripts to multi-character VR scenes, used in a deployed resilience-training program; the authors report that it will be released as open source.
works.method_zh: 从脚本到多角色 VR 场景的自动化创作流程，已用于实际部署的韧性训练项目；作者称将以开源形式发布。

paper.title: Inceptor: Automated Generation of Social Scenarios in Virtual Reality

works.title: AI-Enhanced Virtual Reality Self-Talk for Psychological Counseling: Formative Qualitative Study
works.description: Adds an AI agent to embodied VR self-talk, where people alternate between their own avatar and a counsellor avatar; the agent steps in with guidance when participants get stuck, and a formative qualitative study explored how people experienced its help.
works.description_zh: 在 VR 具身自我对话（参与者在自己的化身与咨询者化身之间切换）中加入一个 AI 智能体，在参与者卡住时介入引导；一项形成性质性研究探讨了参与者如何体验这种帮助。
works.idea_en: Instead of replacing the therapist, the LLM nudges a person's own reasoning, a lower-risk role for generative agents in clinical VR.
works.idea_zh: 大语言模型不是取代治疗师，而是推动当事人自己的思考——这是生成式智能体在临床 VR 中风险较低的角色。
works.method: Formative qualitative study with interviews after AI-supported VR self-talk sessions, by Reichman University's Advanced Reality Lab with Mel Slater.
works.method_zh: 形成性质性研究，在 AI 辅助的 VR 自我对话后进行访谈，由赖克曼大学先进现实实验室与 Mel Slater 合作完成。

paper.title: AI-Enhanced Virtual Reality Self-Talk for Psychological Counseling: Formative Qualitative Study

works.title: Milo: an LLM-based virtual human open-source platform for extended reality
works.description: Open-source system for putting LLM-driven virtual humans into VR and AR applications, demonstrated as a single conversational agent, an attendee of a multi-user VR meeting, a helper in a VR self-talk session and a participant in an AR live event.
works.description_zh: 开源系统，可把由大语言模型驱动的虚拟人接入 VR 与 AR 应用；论文展示了它作为单个对话智能体、多人 VR 会议参与者、VR 自我对话助手以及 AR 现场活动参与者的用法。
works.idea_en: Open, lab-owned virtual-human stacks matter for research: a study can pin the prompt, model and behavior pipeline it actually ran.
works.idea_zh: 开放、由实验室掌控的虚拟人技术栈对研究很重要：一项研究可以锁定它实际使用的提示词、模型与行为管线。
works.method: Architecture that integrates speech recognition, an LLM, speech synthesis and avatar animation into XR platforms, with lessons from several deployments.
works.method_zh: 把语音识别、大语言模型、语音合成与化身动画集成到 XR 平台中的架构，并总结了多次部署的经验。

paper.title: Milo: an LLM-based virtual human open-source platform for extended reality

works.title: CoEmpaTeam: Enhancing Cognitive Empathy using LLM-based Avatars and Dynamic Role Play in Virtual Reality
works.description: VR system for training cognitive empathy in which users work with three LLM-driven avatars of clearly different personalities and switch roles to see situations through another person's eyes; the personalities were validated in an online experiment (n=90) and the system was tested in a lab study (n=32).
works.description_zh: 用于训练认知共情的 VR 系统：用户与三个性格迥异、由大语言模型驱动的化身协作，并通过角色互换从他人视角体验情境；化身性格在线上实验（n=90）中得到验证，系统在实验室研究（n=32）中接受了评估。
works.idea_en: Personality becomes a controllable, pre-validated parameter of LLM characters, a step toward treating generated people as calibrated stimuli.
works.idea_zh: 性格成为大语言模型角色可控且经预先验证的参数——朝着把生成的人物视为“经过校准的刺激”迈出了一步。
works.method: LLM-driven avatars with prompted personalities, technical and online validation of perceived personality, then a lab experiment on cognitive-empathy outcomes.
works.method_zh: 以提示词设定性格的大语言模型化身，先进行技术评估与线上性格感知验证，再开展关于认知共情结果的实验室实验。

paper.title: CoEmpaTeam: Enhancing Cognitive Empathy using LLM-based Avatars and Dynamic Role Play in Virtual Reality

works.title: Exploring the Use of Large Language Model-Driven Chatbots in Virtual Reality to Train Autistic Individuals in Job Communication Skills
works.description: VR application in which autistic trainees practise customer conversations by speaking with avatars driven by GPT-3.5 Turbo, while job coaches create the training scenarios by writing text prompts; a preliminary study involved three trainees and two job coaches.
works.description_zh: 一款 VR 应用：自闭症受训者通过语音与 GPT-3.5 Turbo 驱动的化身练习与顾客对话，就业辅导员则通过撰写文字提示来创建训练情境；初步研究有三名受训者和两名就业辅导员参与。
works.idea_en: Prompting replaces branching scripts, so the coach rather than a developer authors the scenario: the VR-JIT idea with the authoring bottleneck removed.
works.idea_zh: 提示词取代了分支脚本，于是由辅导员而非开发者来编写情境——这是去掉了创作瓶颈的 VR-JIT 思路。
works.method: Speech-to-text, LLM response generation and text-to-speech for VR avatars, evaluated in a preliminary usability study; the RIT lab has since extended the line to environment-grounded role play.
works.method_zh: 为 VR 化身串联语音转文字、大语言模型生成回复与文字转语音，并进行初步可用性研究；罗切斯特理工学院团队随后把这条研究线扩展到与环境关联的角色扮演。

paper.title: Exploring the Use of Large Language Model-Driven Chatbots in Virtual Reality to Train Autistic Individuals in Job Communication Skills

works.title: Artificial intelligence (AI) for virtual reality exposure therapy (VRET): A systematic review
works.description: PRISMA systematic review of 23 peer-reviewed articles, published up to November 2025, on using artificial intelligence to tailor VR exposure therapy to the needs of patients and therapists.
works.description_zh: 按 PRISMA 流程纳入截至 2025 年 11 月发表的 23 篇同行评审文章，系统梳理如何用人工智能让 VR 暴露疗法更贴合患者与治疗师的需要。
works.idea_en: Adaptive exposure, adjusting the feared situation to the patient in the moment, is the clinical use case closest to real-time generation, and its evidence base is still small.
works.idea_zh: 自适应暴露——根据患者当下状态调整所恐惧的情境——是最接近实时生成的临床用例，而其证据基础仍然有限。
works.method: Systematic review following PRISMA across PsycINFO, Web of Science, Google Scholar, EMBASE, CINAHL and MEDLINE; 23 of 377 screened records included.
works.method_zh: 遵循 PRISMA 的系统综述，检索 PsycINFO、Web of Science、Google Scholar、EMBASE、CINAHL 与 MEDLINE，从 377 条记录中纳入 23 篇。

paper.title: Artificial intelligence (AI) for virtual reality exposure therapy (VRET): A systematic review

works.title: VR scuba diving with harbor seals increases ocean connectedness, and the effect of conversational AI on pro-environmental engagement depends on prior experience with seals
works.description: In OceanSpeak, participants scuba-dive in VR and talk with an AI-powered harbor seal about ocean acidification and overfishing. A preregistered study (N=106) used a yoked control: control participants saw identical content, including another participant's AI conversation, but could not talk themselves.
works.description_zh: 在 OceanSpeak 中，参与者在 VR 里潜水，并与一只 AI 驱动的港海豹谈论海洋酸化与过度捕捞。一项预注册研究（N=106）采用“配对对照”设计：对照组看到完全相同的内容，包括另一位参与者与 AI 的对话，但自己不能开口。
works.idea_en: Yoked controls address the core problem of studying generative conversation: each control sees exactly what a treated participant got, which isolates the effect of interacting.
works.idea_zh: 配对对照解决了研究生成式对话的核心难题：每个对照者看到的正是某位实验组参与者得到的内容，从而分离出“互动”本身的效应。
works.method: Preregistered between-subjects experiment with Stanford's Virtual Human Interaction Lab using yoked replay of AI conversations; outcomes were ocean connectedness, empathy with seals, pro-ocean behaviors and knowledge.
works.method_zh: 与斯坦福虚拟人交互实验室合作的预注册被试间实验，以配对回放 AI 对话作为对照；结局指标包括海洋联结感、对海豹的共情、护海行为与知识。

paper.title: VR scuba diving with harbor seals increases ocean connectedness, and the effect of conversational AI on pro-environmental engagement depends on prior experience with seals

works.title: A Latency-Optimized LLM-based Multimodal Dialogue System for Embodied Conversational Agents in VR
works.description: Dialogue system that shortens response latency for an LLM-driven embodied guide in a VR museum, who helps visitors explore artworks and artists with spoken replies and gestures.
works.description_zh: 为 VR 博物馆中由大语言模型驱动的具身导览员设计的对话系统，缩短其响应延迟；导览员以语音和手势帮助参观者了解艺术品与艺术家。
works.idea_en: Turn-taking delay is the first thing that breaks plausibility with LLM characters, so engineering for latency is part of the experimental apparatus.
works.idea_zh: 轮流发言的延迟是大语言模型角色最先破坏似真性的地方，因此为延迟做工程优化本身就是实验装置的一部分。
works.method: Multimodal agent pipeline (speech recognition, LLM, speech synthesis, gesture) optimized for end-to-end latency, likely by overlapping stages; a follow-up study on engagement appeared at IEEE AIxVR 2026.
works.method_zh: 针对端到端延迟优化的多模态智能体管线（语音识别、大语言模型、语音合成、手势），很可能通过各环节并行重叠来实现；关于参与度的后续研究发表于 IEEE AIxVR 2026。

paper.title: A Latency-Optimized LLM-based Multimodal Dialogue System for Embodied Conversational Agents in VR

works.title: Where extended reality and AI may take us: Ethical issues of impersonation and AI fakes in social virtual reality
works.description: At IEEE VR 2025 a panel was held in social VR with each panellist in a look-alike avatar; midway two panellists swapped avatars and impersonated each other, and an LLM-controlled Alan Turing avatar took part. About 40 of the 100 audience members who answered a survey did not notice the swap.
works.description_zh: IEEE VR 2025 大会上，一场小组讨论在社交 VR 中进行，每位嘉宾都使用与本人相貌相似的化身；中途两位嘉宾互换化身并假扮对方，另有一个由大语言模型控制的艾伦·图灵化身参与讨论。在填写问卷的 100 名观众中，约 40 人没有察觉这次互换。
works.idea_en: Look-alike avatars plus LLM agents make identity itself manipulable, so studies with generated people need disclosure and consent rules of their own.
works.idea_zh: 相貌相似的化身加上大语言模型智能体，让“身份”本身变得可以操纵——使用生成人物的研究需要专属的告知与同意规则。
works.method: Field study during a live conference panel projected to the audience, with a post-panel survey on detecting the swap and perceiving the AI panellist.
works.method_zh: 在现场会议小组讨论中开展的实地研究，画面投影给观众，会后以问卷调查观众是否察觉互换以及如何看待 AI 嘉宾。

paper.title: Where extended reality and AI may take us: Ethical issues of impersonation and AI fakes in social virtual reality
